name: ashlar/standard
title: Commitments table
description: The promises written into every contract, as a table: clause, commitment, what it means in practice and the measure.

lede.default: These four are clauses in every contract we sign, along with what we owe you if we break one.

default.detail: One survey visit, then an itemised quote. The figure you sign is the figure you pay unless you change the brief, and any change is priced in writing before work starts.
Photos, progress against the programme and next week's plan, in your inbox by 5pm.
So the people who priced your job are the ones running it, and your site manager isn't spread thin across the city.
Insurance-backed and transferable if you sell. If something structural fails, we come back and put it right.

footnote.default: If a Friday report is late, £100 comes off your final invoice. It has happened twice since 2019.
